scope: Complete 18-measure written-note practice with all original sources retained; expressive performance is not equivalent

independent_source_to_canonical.voice_mapping: Each MSCX staff contains one implicit sequential voice. Converter labels 1/1/5 preserve those three staff-local lanes; labels are serialization identifiers.
independent_source_to_canonical.spelling_method: Source MIDI pitch plus the numeric MuseScore TPC spelling values; exact step/alter/octave compared with canonical notes

maps.measures: All 54 source staff-measures independently sum to 4 quarter beats; 18 canonical shared measures exactly match every onset/length

tempo_and_key.key_limit: An unmarked source signature becomes zero fifths; no major/minor mode is inferred

raw_reference.normal_midi_import_error: MIDI controller 121 is unsupported; it may change pitch, timing or note-release behavior. Its effects cannot be inferred safely

agreement.interpretation: Reference software note-ons/key-noteoffs, not acoustic sustain or musical truth. Generated ornaments, fermatas, articulation, dynamics, channels and repeat policies may differ. Every mismatch remains visible; this is not an automatic acceptance score.

written_beat_attack_agreement.interpretation: Pitch/onset inventories in written quarter beats only; ignores expression and tempo realization, does not erase the separate wall-clock mismatch report.

raw_reference.limits: Controller 121 causes normal MIDI import refusal; raw inspection also retains controller 2 and other unimplemented channel behavior. MIDI keys are observations only. Matching 198 onsets does not establish articulation, dynamics, key release, acoustic sustain or equivalent expressive performance.

source_rendering.finding: The retained MuseScore PNG subtitle 6 Lieder, Op.48 overlaps the main title. Musical systems, lyrics, clefs, dynamics, staccato marks, ties and CC0 credit are visible. The original PNG is unchanged.
source_rendering.layout_scope: App engraving is a separate representation of canonical notes; no claim that it reproduces this source layout

importer_warnings.message: Imported sounding notes, rests, voices, staves and basic timing. Engraving, clefs, layout, lyrics and other visual details remain in the exact original MusicXML source; this is not a lossless notation editor.
MusicXML MIDI programs, channels and devices remain in the source. The practice app selects its own sound for each named instrument.
MusicXML <clef> is retained in the original source only; its notation or performance instructions are not interpreted.
MusicXML <words> is retained in the original source only; its notation or performance instructions are not interpreted.
MusicXML <sound @dynamics> is retained in the original source only; its notation or performance instructions are not interpreted.
MusicXML <dynamics> is retained in the original source only; its notation or performance instructions are not interpreted.
MusicXML <articulations> is retained in the original source only; its notation or performance instructions are not interpreted.

acceptance_scope: Source/converter and written-note evaluation only. Application rendering, source-download, library/backup and instrument-target acceptance are separately checked by the admission commit tests; this record does not assert an unrun hosted result.
